06 ☕

Four Pillars of OOP

Core principles

  • Encapsulation — binding data and methods together
  • Inheritance — reusing properties and methods of another class
  • Polymorphism — one method/interface behaving in different ways
  • Abstraction — hiding implementation details, showing essential features
07 ☕

Digital Wallet Project

Mini project

    ### 💳 Digital Wallet — Java Project
  • Developed a **Java-based Digital Wallet** for managing user accounts and transactions.
  • Implemented **add money, withdraw money, transfer money, and balance checking** features.
  • Used **OOP concepts** such as Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and Abstraction.
  • Used **arrays and basic operations** for data management.
  • Added a **menu-driven interface** for easy interaction.
  • Focused on **secure and organized transaction management.
